summary: Iteration 111: Multi-Premiação System Testing - All 20 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified: /cadastro page loads without CadastroTermoModal error, /votacao shows list of premiacoes with active/closed sections, voting detail shows categories with countdown timer, admin Premiação tab shows CRUD operations with editable fields, voting banner on main page works correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <tr> cannot be a child of <span>' - hydration error warning (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend (premiacao_routes.py): Multi-premiacao CRUD working correctly with admin endpoints
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/status returns premiacao_id for backward compatibility
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/ativas returns list of active premiacoes
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/todas returns all premiacoes
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/p/{id} returns single premiacao with all fields
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/p/{id}/categorias returns categories list
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/p/{id}/regulamento returns regulamento text
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes creates new premiacao
Backend: PUT /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id} updates titulo, subtitulo, modo_votacao, regulamento
Backend: DELETE /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id} deletes premiacao with all related data
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id}/abrir opens voting
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id}/fechar closes voting
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id}/categorias creates category
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/admin/premiacoes/{id}/exportar-excel exports Excel file
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/p/{id}/meus-votos returns athlete votes
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/p/{id}/voto-finalizado returns finalization status
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/p/{id}/votar requires auth and validates closed premiacao
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/p/{id}/finalizar requires all categories voted
Frontend (CadastroPage.js): CadastroTermoModal import fixed - page loads without error
Frontend (VotacaoPage.jsx): Shows list of premiacoes with active/closed sections
Frontend (VotacaoPage.jsx): Voting detail shows categories, countdown timer, regulamento button
Frontend (VotacaoPage.jsx): 'Faça login para votar' message for non-logged users
Frontend (DashboardPremiacao.jsx): Admin CRUD with editable titulo, subtitulo, modo, regulamento
Frontend (DashboardPremiacao.jsx): Date inputs for abertura/encerramento programadas
Frontend (DashboardPremiacao.jsx): Excel export, Regulamento, Nova Categoria buttons
Frontend (RankingPage.js): Voting banner shows when votacao_aberta=true, navigates to /votacao
seed_data_creation: None - used existing migrated data (premiacao '310d78e2' with 2 categories, 3 votes) and test premiacao '38191d93' (Votação Cor da Camisa 2026, closed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 111 validated the complete multi-premiacao system: (1) Backend CRUD for premiacoes working, (2) Backend voting endpoints working with auth and validation, (3) Backend backward compatibility with /api/premiacao/status returning premiacao_id, (4) Frontend /cadastro loads without CadastroTermoModal error, (5) Frontend /votacao shows list of premiacoes with active/closed sections, (6) Frontend voting detail shows categories with countdown timer and regulamento button, (7) Frontend admin Premiação tab shows CRUD with editable fields, (8) Frontend main page voting banner works and navigates to /votacao. Two premiacoes exist: 'PRÊMIO NACIONAL RANKING RUN' (id: 310d78e2, open, 2 categories, 3 votes) and 'Votação Cor da Camisa 2026' (id: 38191d93, closed, 0 categories).
